query: SELECT ca.receivableId, ar_id.id as ar_by_id, ar_mx.id as ar_by_maxiprodId FROM collection_actions ca LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar_id ON ar_id.id = ca.receivableId LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar_mx ON ar_mx.maxiprodId = ca.receivableId LIMIT 5;
